content.short: Cashtree is Indonesia's leading mobile advertising and rewards platform that is transitioning millions of users to Web3 through the Mantle Network.
content.description: Cashtree is a massive mobile rewards ecosystem in Indonesia that has successfully onboarded over 20 million users to its digital advertising platform. By transitioning to Web3 via the Mantle Network, Cashtree is empowering its user base to earn and trade its native CTT token on-chain. This integration leverages Mantle's scalability and low transaction costs to provide a seamless and inclusive financial bridge for millions of users entering the blockchain space.
content.meta: Cashtree is a leading mobile rewards platform transitioning millions of users to Mantle. Discover Cashtree on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
